title: Confirm access with an emailed code
purpose: Reconfirm your identity before an account-sensitive action by entering a one-time code sent to one of your verified email addresses.
summary: Confirm it is you before a sensitive account change, with a one-time code sent to one of your verified email addresses.

tasks.title: Get a code
steps: Choose the address in [[Recipient]]. Only verified addresses are offered.

tasks.title: Enter the code and continue
steps: Type the code from the latest email in [[Code]] within five minutes.
Select [[Confirm]]. The action you started continues.

tasks.title: Get a new code
steps: Select [[Request new code]]. It replaces earlier codes.

good_to_know: Verify an address on the Email addresses page first if none is offered.
A new code does not restart the five-minute deadline.
A confirmation counts as recent for five minutes.

items.label: Recipient
items.description: Choose which of your verified email addresses receives the code. Only verified addresses are offered; verify an address on the Email addresses page first if none appears.

items.label: Request Code
items.description: Sends a one-time code to the chosen address and opens the code entry page. Requests are rate limited; a field error appears when the limit is reached.

items.label: Code
items.description: Required one-time code from the latest email. Enter it in this browser window within five minutes of the request. An incorrect code shows a field error, and repeated unsuccessful submissions abandon the attempt.

items.label: Confirm
items.description: Records a recent successful identity check, verifies the address the code was sent to and resumes the protected operation or returns to the application destination.

items.label: Request new code
items.description: Emails a replacement to the same address and invalidates earlier codes. The number of replacements is limited, and resending does not restart the five-minute deadline.

sections.title: Availability
paragraphs: Requires sign-in. This is an alternative to confirming your password for actions that need a recent identity check, such as managing two-factor authentication; a recent check lasts five minutes. If no code attempt is pending in the current browser session, the code entry page returns to the request page. The page is refused if email-code reauthentication is not enabled for the deployment. The code proves access to the address; it does not change roles or permissions.
